reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26079396 (2026-09-28T23:59:59Z), asset() identifies USDT, totalAssets() is 397809076331145 and USDT balanceOf(spUSDT) is 77934639501976, both in 6-decimal units. This separates measured idle USDT from the 80.409034348653% non-idle accounting exposure. SparkVault permits TAKER_ROLE to withdraw assets and computes totalAssets from shares and accrued chi; the remainder is a Spark protocol position rather than proof of a reconciled downstream portfolio. Its constituent asset, venue and custodian weights remain unknown. No hard maturity maximum is disclosed, so maturityDaysMax is omitted.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Archive eth_call of asset(), totalAssets() and USDT balanceOf(spUSDT) at Ethereum block 26079396; category-level classification from the pinned Spark vault implementation and address registry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Spark names SparkLend, Morpho, Maple syrupUSDT, Curve and sUSDS in its strategy framework and publishes a May 5, 2026 deployment snapshot. Those historical aggregate amounts do not reconcile the current spUSDT liabilities. The 80.409034348653% non-idle position therefore retains unknown current constituent weights, downstream custody shares and maturity bounds; category-level classification does not admit the live-withheld fallback.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The pinned contract permits the taker to pull vault liquidity. The observed idle USDT remains in the vault, while non-idle accounting exposure has no reconciled spUSDT-specific downstream custody allocation, segregation, insolvency treatment or successor-custody disclosure. No provider percentage is assigned from the accounting remainder.
